claim: The TV show starring Will Smith was written by the creator of "The Borowitz Report". This show also starred Joseph Marcell.
evidencia:
Page: Andy Borowitz. Sentence: Andy Borowitz (born January 4, 1958) is an American writer, comedian, satirist, and actor.
Page: Andy Borowitz. Sentence: He is known for creating "The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air" and the satirical column "The Borowitz Report".
Page: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air. Sentence: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air is an American sitcom that originally aired on NBC from September 10, 1990, to May 20, 1996.
Page: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air. Sentence: The show stars Will Smith as a fictionalized version of himself, a street-smart teenager from West Philadelphia who is sent to move in with his wealthy aunt and uncle in their Bel Air mansion after getting into a fight on a local basketball court.
Page: Joseph Marcell. Sentence: Joseph Marcell (born 18 August 1948) is a Saint Lucian born British actor, best known for his role as Geoffrey the butler on the NBC sitcom "The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air" from September 1990, until it ended in May 1996.
